# Three Kubernetes manifests in one stream.
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-config
  labels: &labels
    app: web
    tier: frontend
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  CACHE_TTL: "300"
---
# The deployment reuses the label set through an anchor.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
    tier: frontend
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: &match
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: *match
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: registry.example.invalid/web:1.10
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
